extensionUpdate.landingTitle: One hub. More ways to watch and read.
extensionUpdate.landingBody: Mix Tatakai packages, Stremio add-ons and Seanime providers with compatible CloudStream, Mihon, Aniyomi, Sora and Mangayomi sources. Browse by language, install a community stack, or connect your own extension server.
extensionUpdate.compatibilityNote: Compatibility depends on your app, platform and each source. Local runtimes require a supported installed app; a listed ecosystem does not guarantee every extension works.
extensionUpdate.faqIntro: Tatakai supports multiple extension ecosystems and community-hosted servers. Use the guide below to choose a source that matches your device, language and reading or playback needs.
extensionUpdate.nativeDetail: Install .kai packages in the app for supported source, theme and utility capabilities.
extensionUpdate.cloudDetail: Original source packages through a compatible local runtime in supported app builds. Host APIs and device support vary.
extensionUpdate.mihonDetail: Browse manga, load chapters and read pages through the compatible native host. Requires a supported installed app.
extensionUpdate.aniyomiDetail: Browse anime and resolve episodes through the compatible native host. Requires a supported installed app.
extensionUpdate.soraDetail: Compatible JavaScript modules run in the local interpreter. Source APIs and device behavior vary.
extensionUpdate.mangayomiDetail: Compatible JavaScript anime and manga sources. Dart, novels and advanced host APIs are not generally supported.
extensionUpdate.serverDetail: Connect a community-hosted Tatakai Server by address or pairing link. Source availability and access are managed by its owner.
extensionUpdate.qTypes: Which extension ecosystems can I use?
extensionUpdate.aTypes: Tatakai packages, Stremio add-ons and compatible Seanime, CloudStream, Mihon, Aniyomi, Sora and Mangayomi sources. Capabilities vary by provider and platform; local compatibility runtimes need a supported installed app.
extensionUpdate.qInstall: How do I install an extension from the website?
extensionUpdate.aInstall: Choose an extension in the hub and open it in Tatakai. The installed app handles package installation and permissions. You can also import a supported package from a file. Review compatibility before installing.
extensionUpdate.qStacks: Can I install several extensions together?
extensionUpdate.aStacks: Yes. Community stacks group up to 20 eligible extensions. Sign in to the extension portal to create a stack, or open a published stack in Tatakai. Language and adult-content preferences still apply.
extensionUpdate.qServers: Can I publish or connect my own server?
extensionUpdate.aServers: Yes. Connect a server in Extension Servers, or submit a public HTTPS Tatakai Server address in the developer portal for review. After approval, others can choose Connect in Tatakai. Enter viewer passwords only in the connection dialog; do not publish credentials or pairing codes.
extensionUpdate.qWorking: Does a supported format guarantee a working source?
extensionUpdate.aWorking: No. Websites can change or go offline, and some extensions require unsupported host APIs or account access. Check the compatibility label and runtime status. The website does not execute local extension runtimes.
extensionUpdate.dartLimit: Mangayomi Dart sources, novel sources and unimplemented advanced host APIs
